justification: Inspected gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/package-info.java and the exact-package classes under gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/*.java: 16 classes, 3160 total LOC. The package concentrates many unrelated core responsibilities in one place, including object construction and unsafe instantiation (ConstructorConstructor.java, UnsafeAllocator.java), exclusion policy (Excluder.java), type utilities (GsonTypes.java, Primitives.java, JavaVersion.java), stream/tree I/O (Streams.java), a custom map implementation (LinkedTreeMap.java), and other cross-cutting helpers (NumberLimits.java, ReflectionAccessFilterHelper.java, LazilyParsedNumber.java, PreJava9DateFormatProvider.java, TroubleshootingGuide.java). Gson.java, GsonBuilder.java, and TypeToken.java import these internals directly, showing the package is a central hub rather than a narrowly focused component.
